headline: Detention orders issued for 41 executives in excessive pricing investigation | Economy
summary: Detention orders were issued for 41 executives of major distributors in the 'Price journey from field to market' investigation into excessive pricing, and 33 have been caught.
why: Regulators' pricing probes into distributors affect margins, consumer prices and the competitive environment for listed retail and food companies.
